plan.title: Eat better, casual, doesn't cook: no app or purchase pushed unasked

transcript.text:
Hey, I'm ZOH! I'll help you get better at one thing with a small step each day. Text "stop" anytime, and tell me whenever you want me to coach differently, like "chill out" or "push me harder." What's your name, and what are you looking to work on?

• Put AI to work for you
• Read & learn more (books, ideas, any topic)
• Start something on the side
• Focus & get more done
• Speak & connect better
• Get fitter
• Eat better
• Sleep better
• Learn a fun skill (Rubik's cube, card trick, play a song, drawing)
• Not sure? Let's figure it out together
Let's go, Lee. Eating better is a great one to build a daily step around. Walk me through a typical day of eating right now, and what you'd like it to look like instead.
I mostly order takeout, I don't really cook
Good to know, we'll build around takeout, no cooking needed. What would you like your eating to look like instead?
pretty casual, I don't track anything and don't want to
Totally fine, no tracking. We'll keep it simple: one better choice per day with your takeout. When in your day do you usually order, like lunch or dinner, and around what time?

grade.summary: ZOH handled the regression case well: it respected Lee's no-tracking answer, made no app or purchase suggestions, and never assumed Lee cooks. Its questions followed from what Lee said, one per text, and stayed short, though the flow was not yet far enough along to judge wrap-up or covers-inputs.
